name: MoonStone
author: chipzz
description: Time two quick jumps after clicking the pink orb at 3% to go up between the saw and ball portal as the UFO. Don’t click until 4% where you have to spam above the first spike and then click the green orb to move to the ceiling. Spam at the floor from 43%-50% and then stay slightly above the ceiling until 52% where you can fall back to it. Go into the ship portal on the ceiling at 60%. Continue playing normally from there.
